title: Visiting bands at the Grand Terrace
summary: Tate, Basie, Henderson, Dickerson came in when Hines toured.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I also read that sometimes there would be another band there, like Tate's band played there, and that according to Earl, Ed Fox, in the early days particularly, was unsure about the band, and he'd have other
bands in to see what the people's reaction to that was, and he was always asking other people what they thought of the band, the waiters, you know, and the stars that came in, and so forth.
I'm trying to think -- prior to that. I don't remember that.
Well, I guess maybe Earl --
From the time I joined the band in '31, everything went along smooth until the band disbanded in '39. Now, we had -- like when we went on the road, we had other bands come in.
Oh, yeah.
Tate was one of the bands, Count Basie was one of the bands.
Yeah, that was his first engagement outside of Kansas City.
First engagement. Yeah. Carroll Dickerson.
Fletcher Henderson worked there.
Fletcher Henderson, that's right. Fletcher Henderson come in.
Roy and Chu Berry.
Roy and Ch. And the drummer.
Sid Catlett?
Sid Catlett.
HEMLOCK ERASABLE COTTON CONTENT
Named my son after Sid Catlett.
Yeah? That's where I met Sid, when he come in with Fletcher Henderson.
Well, he'd been around Chicago before --
He'd been around before, and he went to New York.
Sammy Stewart --
And joined -- yeah. Then he joined Fletcher Henderson, then he came back and he chaired for Fletcher. He was a New York musician then.
